description: Makes complete short films entirely in code: describe a story, pick one of 66 styles (each shipped with a demo film), and the agent directs and renders it with Node/canvas/Three.js and ffmpeg — no video generator involved.
why: End-to-end code-film production, a genuinely distinct job from cinematic-director's planning layer; listed link-only to keep the collection's motion cluster to one vendored representative.
